name: Nexchip Semiconductor Corporation
summary: Nexchip Semiconductor Corporation engages in the research, development, production, and sale of integrated circuit related products in China and internationally. The company operates a foundry specializing in wafer manufacturing. It offers various integrated circuit categories, including display driver ICs (DDIC) that enable display control, complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor image sensors (CIS) that enable image sensing; power management ICs (PMIC) that regulate and optimize power usage; and Logic ICs, which support data processing, and microcontroller units (MCU).
